title: Entity Gate
text: Gate entities, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Operating mode} sets Select the mode of operation Enable; {Matching attribute} sets the name of the attribute that matches the value from the control port, {Initial value from the control port} sets the initial value from the control port to match the matching attribute and {Open gate at simulation start} sets the opening the gate at the start. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Operating mode
params.values: Select the mode of operation Enable gate (default) | Release gate | Selection gate

params.name: Matching attribute
params.values: Specify name of the attribute that matches the value from the control port Attribute1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial value from the control port
params.values: Specify initial value from the control port to match the matching attribute NaN (default) | scalar

params.name: Open gate at simulation start
params.values: Opening the gate at the start off (default) | on
